evals.name: coverage-first
evals.prompt: I just rewrote the description of our deploy skill. Before I open the PR, how do I check that it still triggers on the requests people actually type, and what would the run cost? Give me the exact commands, don't run anything.
evals.expected_output: Checks eval coverage with repo-skill-evals --list, then runs a trigger-only pass with runs 1 and a cost ceiling, and compares before and after on the same cases.
assertions: Runs repo-skill-evals --list (or names eval coverage) before scoring anything
Proposes a --trigger-only run with a bounded cost (--max-cost-usd or --runs 1)
Says the description, not the prompt, is what to fix when the skill does not fire

evals.name: sandbox-safe-prompts
evals.prompt: Our on-call skill's evals keep failing with errors about not being able to reach the hosts. Should I give the eval runner SSH access? What would you change instead? Just explain, no commands needed.
evals.expected_output: Explains that runs are sandboxed without hosts, credentials or a checkout, so prompts should ask for the plan, exact commands or a decision and assertions should check those; does not grant the runner access.
assertions: Says eval runs are sandboxed with no live hosts, credentials or repository checkout
Recommends rewriting the prompts to ask for a plan, commands or a decision rather than granting access
Does not recommend giving the runner SSH or real credentials
